subject.title: Feature: allow account switching from /models buttons for GPT and Claude

question: Should `/models` expose first-class account/auth-profile selection for provider-backed models across Telegram and Discord, and what shared picker contract should channels use?
rationale: This is a cross-channel auth/provider/session UX decision, not a narrow bug: maintainers need to choose how it coexists with `/model ...@profile`, auth order, callback size limits, and session persistence.

options.title: Define shared picker profile contract
options.body: Add profile/account metadata and typed select actions to the shared picker contract, then implement the same semantics in Telegram and Discord.

options.title: Keep typed command path only
options.body: Document `/model ...@profile` and auth order as the supported account-switching flow, then close or defer this picker UX request.

options.title: Pilot one channel first
options.body: Implement an experimental account picker in one channel with explicit follow-up before treating it as the shared contract.

recommendation.title: Define shared picker profile contract
recommendation.body: Add profile/account metadata and typed select actions to the shared picker contract, then implement the same semantics in Telegram and Discord.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans the shared `/models` command, provider identity changes, session helper docs, and both Telegram/Discord picker maintenance.
